technique_name: Give an example of a successful negotiation and explain why it was effective.
description: One example of a successful negotiation was between the shareholders of a company and a potential buyer. The shareholders were trying to sell their stake in the company, but the buyer was offering a lower price than they had expected. To make the negotiation successful, the shareholders proposed a deal in which the buyer could purchase a minority stake in the company, giving them access to the company’s technology and team but leaving the majority of control in the hands of the shareholders.
